name: SUPERPOSITION
source:
A visual novel about the action inherent to inaction, turning a blind eye to a friend in need, and hitting a deer with your car.

[From [url=https://hyperthinks.itch.io/superposition]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于“不作为本身也是一种作为”、对身陷困境的朋友袖手旁观，以及开车撞上一头鹿的视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://hyperthinks.itch.io/superposition]itch.io[/url]]
